label: RAZR system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a locus encoding a RAZR zinc-finger HEPN RNase that can form a phage-triggered higher-order ring complex, cleave RNA broadly, inhibit translation, and restrict phage propagation.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual razr genes, RAZR RNase proteins, HEPN or zinc-finger domains, active RAZR ring complexes, nonspecific RNA-cleavage or translation-inhibition activities, phage ring trigger proteins, source database rows naming one RAZR system, DefenseFinder HMM or rule rows absent from the pinned model files, and other antiphage systems such as RADAR, Septu, Gabija, and Sir2-HerA-family systems.
